summary_en: Full-year dividend per share for the fiscal year ending November 2026 raised by 3 yen to 58 yen, with dividend payout ratio of 35.4%. The increase reflects upward revision of consolidated earnings forecast driven by strong real estate rehabilitation and leasing operations, partially offset by strategic deferral of property sales to subsequent periods.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Full-Year Business Performance Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending November 2026
translation_en_brief:
TOSEI Corporation revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending November 30, 2026. The full-year dividend per share was increased by 3 yen from the previously announced 55 yen to 58 yen, reflecting a payout ratio of 35.4%. The company also revised its consolidated earnings forecast upward, with operating profit increased by 449 million yen to 25,061 million yen despite a 9,373 million yen reduction in revenue to 113,613 million yen. The revenue reduction was driven by a strategic deferral of certain real estate rehabilitation property sales from the current fiscal year to subsequent periods.

The earnings improvement stems from strong performance in the company's core operations. The real estate rehabilitation and rental businesses performed well, supported by robust investment appetite from domestic and international investors and rent increases on portfolio properties. The real estate fund and consulting business exceeded initial expectations with higher asset management acquisitions and dispositions, including increased disposition fees.

The company stated that it recognizes stable dividend distribution as a critical management priority while balancing the need for internal reserves to capture high-return business opportunities and enhance long-term corporate value. The dividend increase decision incorporated the upward earnings revision, strategic deferral of property sales, and the achievement of a 35.4% payout ratio, which aligns with the company's dividend policy framework.
